g.text: PROPOSED HEADPHONE PROTECTION (new circuit, not yet in the product schematic)

g.desc: PROPOSED HEADPHONE PROTECTION (new circuit, not yet in the product schematic)

g.text: Each amplifier output is level-shifted to 1.25 V and low-pass filtered at 0.3 Hz (R1-R4, C1-C2).

g.desc: Each amplifier output is level-shifted to 1.25 V and low-pass filtered at 0.3 Hz (R1-R4, C1-C2).

g.text: U1-U4 trip if the filtered output leaves +/-100 mV DC. U5/U6 trip if either +/-5 V rail is below 4.5 V.

g.desc: U1-U4 trip if the filtered output leaves +/-100 mV DC. U5/U6 trip if either +/-5 V rail is below 4.5 V.

g.text: Any trip discharges C3 (FAULT_N). U7 lets the MCU request reach Q4 only once C3 has recharged (~0.7 s).

g.desc: Any trip discharges C3 (FAULT_N). U7 lets the MCU request reach Q4 only once C3 has recharged (~0.7 s).

g.text: Q4, D1 and K1 are the driver, clamp and relay already drawn in the product schematic.

g.desc: Q4, D1 and K1 are the driver, clamp and relay already drawn in the product schematic.

g.text: Comparators and relay are behavioural models (study_models.lib); the relay opens when coil current

g.desc: Comparators and relay are behavioural models (study_models.lib); the relay opens when coil current

g.text: falls below 3.3 mA, plus 3 ms. Coil inductance 0.2 H is an estimate.

g.desc: falls below 3.3 mA, plus 3 ms. Coil inductance 0.2 H is an estimate.

g.text: Stimulus: V7 steps the left amplifier output to +4.5 V DC at 100 ms. Plot HP_L, GATE, FAULT_N.

g.desc: Stimulus: V7 steps the left amplifier output to +4.5 V DC at 100 ms. Plot HP_L, GATE, FAULT_N.

g.text: The 2.4 s power-on delay is not visible here because this run starts from steady state.

g.desc: The 2.4 s power-on delay is not visible here because this run starts from steady state.
